Questions

What is the median annual wage for Plumbers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $95,230.

What is the hourly median for Plumbers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $45.78.

How many Plumbers work in Seattle?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 6,350 wage-and-salary Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Plumbers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.02. Values above 1.00 mean Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters are more concentrated in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Plumbers in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $96,250.

How does Seattle's Plumbers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Seattle's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($95,230) is $32,420 higher than Austin ($62,810) and $8,150 lower than Chicago ($103,380). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
